title: Jakarta
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Jakarta, red Player card. Coordinates 6°12'32"S 106°50'44"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. One covered SEARCH box fills the map. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-04b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Companion Builder. Play this card at any time to place a shelter on one city on the grid.

states.summary: Same Player back. The SEARCH box is scratched. Companion Builder. Play this card at any time to place a shelter on one city on the grid.

rules: Red Player card for Jakarta. Port: the compass has an anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
The scratch reveals Companion Builder. Play this card at any time to place a shelter onto one city on the grid. The shelter does not have to be Jakarta, and the text does not call it an action.
Playing the card spends it. The text does not say to destroy it.
notes: Card id 10703. State 2 card id 10725. One copy.
Coordinates 6°12'32"S 106°50'44"E. Printed code P3-04b stays on the scratched face.
When the package is opened, this Player card goes to the Player discard pile, not the reserve.
The portrait is a person in a hard hat. No door number is printed in the box.
